features.title: First recorded prediction from live prices and memory, resolved by code
criteria: Prices are stored every 5 minutes and survive a process restart
A decision session refuses to run on prices older than 15 minutes
A prediction cannot be recorded without probability, condition, horizon and hypothesis link
A recorded prediction cannot be updated or deleted through the agent's tools
At its horizon, code resolves the prediction from stored prices and computes its Brier score
Resolution appends one evidence row to the linked hypothesis and updates its computed confidence
/statut shows open and resolved predictions in French
Tests make no network or paid inference calls
